baseline_prompt_en: A documentary photograph for a restaurant story shows an adult server wiping spilled water from a stainless-steel counter with a cloth at the end of a shift. The counter is still wet, reflecting soft overhead restaurant lights. The server stands close to the counter with a settled stance, pressing a folded cloth through a shallow patch of water with the palm while the elbow remains comfortably bent. A bead of water gathers at the cloth's leading edge and the wiped area behind it has a thinner sheen. Stacked glasses further along the counter suggest closing work. The server's relaxed concentration and the light along the cheek give the small routine a subtle personal warmth. A compact three-quarter view includes the working arm, cloth, remaining water, and steel surface, with the restaurant receding softly behind.
